text:
jordan: Heads-up design drop: thinking of merging Models + Datasets into a single "Assets" group in the left rail to reduce clutter. Quick mock: https://staging.redwood/design/asset-grouping.png

mei: +1 for declutter but worried about new user discoverability. Can we keep direct deep links to each resource? e.g. /console/w/:org/assets/models/:id

sam: We can. Router proposal: add alias redirects so old permalinks keep working. Example rules: /models/:id -> /assets/models/:id (301), /datasets/:id -> /assets/datasets/:id (301). Also preserve query params for panel state.

rachel: Accessibility: the parent group needs aria-expanded, aria-controls, and a live region for state changes so screen readers announce "Assets expanded". Keyboard: header should be focusable and toggle with Enter/Space.

jordan: Naming vote: 'Assets' (short) vs 'Data & Models' (explicit). Thinking of using 'Assets' with hover text "Models & Datasets" so the UI looks tidy but label is clear on focus.

mei: That works. Also suggest a one-time inline cue on first run: "Models moved to Assets  See what changed" with a tour CTA. Support ?tour=assets in routes.

sam: Deep-link example: /console/w/acme/assets/models/123?view=split&panel=metrics&tour=assets. We'll need to persist split and panel state in querystring; otherwise shared links won't reproduce UI.

ci-bot: preview-build: https://staging-console.redwood/preview/assets-mini-map (build 5012)

rachel: From sessions: many users expect Models top-level. Suggest phased rollout: banner for two weeks "Models moved to Assets" with CTA "Show me" and a tour option. A/B test the label (Assets vs Data & Models).

jordan: Action items:
- @sam: implement alias redirects + preserve query state and scroll anchors.
- @mei: update mocks, craft tooltip microcopy, design banner variants.
- @rachel: write research script for A/B and add screen reader acceptance criteria.

mei: Banner copy idea: "Models are now under Assets  View layout or take a guided tour." CTAs: "Show me" / "Take tour"

sam: No infra blockers. I'll add middleware to rewrite legacy shortlinks like /m/:id -> /assets/models/:id temporarily.

rachel: I'll include keyboard nav tests and ensure live-region messages debounce during rapid toggles to avoid spam.

jordan: Target: deploy alpha to staging next Thursday. Flag blockers now. :thumbsup:
